title: 6 Ways to Make Money With the New GPT Agent (It Blew My Mind)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The video is strongly promotional about ChatGPT Agent. The speaker says he does not work for OpenAI and that the video is not an ad; no paid relationship is disclosed.

stated_problem.quote: They're getting pitched websites all day every day, but they don't value a website. So, they're not our customer.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Website services for established businesses
idea.one_liner: Build or improve websites for business owners who already have a site; charge for website work, with pricing not stated.
idea.customer: Business owners, including plumbers and other local businesses.
idea.offer: Website creation or improvement, with prospecting focused on businesses that already have websites.

key_quotes.quote: AI is not going to make that go away. It's just going to make it a more profitable endeavor for people like you and I.
We want to find business owners that already have websites.
So, the first task I'm going to do with Chad GBT agent is ask it to go find 20 plumbers in Nashville that have websites and put as much of their contact information into a Google sheet for me.

acquisition_channels.details: The speaker demonstrates finding plumbers and preparing personalized cold emails to sell them websites.

ideas.delivery: The founder builds websites for business clients; AI agents can research prospects and prepare outreach.

uk_legal_risk.reason: The demonstrated cold-email targeting does not filter for limited companies. In the UK, unsolicited marketing email to sole traders and individual subscribers is restricted; limit outreach to corporate subscribers and include an opt-out.

ideas.other_uk_rules: For UK cold calls, screen numbers against TPS/CTPS. Handle prospect contact data under UK GDPR.
